entries.rationale: Rakazo instance was never configured (blocker); the app is a desktop Electron app drivable by computer use; journey_ux.mode was already agent-led-manual-browser, so the executor identity changes, not the required coverage or real-running-app gate.
consequences: verification-harness.md Rakazo section replaced with ADE computer-use executor note
Journey UX receipts record reviewer identity honestly as 'ADE lane agent via computer use', NOT an independent human or third-party model; no_release_with_blocked_journey still applies
